CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

CREATE TABLE api_tokens (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scopes TEXT DEFAULT 'provisioning:read,provisioning:write' NOT NULL, 
	allowed_ips TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	target VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	detail TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "backup_schedules" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	target_id INTEGER, 
	schedule VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '0 2 * * *' NOT NULL, 
	retention INTEGER DEFAULT '7' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	last_run_at DATETIME, 
	last_status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	last_message TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	user_ids TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	all_users BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_id) REFERENCES sftp_backup_targets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE cloudflare_credentials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	zone VARCHAR(253) NOT NULL, 
	api_token TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "database_accounts" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	website_id INTEGER, 
	db_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	db_user VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	db_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (db_user), 
	FOREIGN KEY(website_id) REFERENCES websites (id), 
	UNIQUE (db_name)
)

CREATE TABLE provisioning_accounts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	primary_website_id INTEGER, 
	package_id INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	last_action VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	last_message TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(primary_website_id) REFERENCES websites (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(package_id) REFERENCES user_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE revoked_tokens (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	jti VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE sftp_backup_targets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	port INTEGER DEFAULT '22' NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password TEXT, 
	private_key TEXT, 
	remote_path VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '/backups/snpanel' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, host_key_type VARCHAR(32), host_key_fingerprint VARCHAR(128), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "site_apps" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'app' NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'proxy' NOT NULL, 
	start_kind VARCHAR(16), 
	start_arg VARCHAR(255), 
	node_major VARCHAR(8), 
	port INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	memory_limit_mb INTEGER DEFAULT '512' NOT NULL, 
	autostart BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'stopped' NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	image VARCHAR(200), 
	container_port INTEGER DEFAULT '3000' NOT NULL, 
	cpu_limit VARCHAR(8) DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	env TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, compose_source TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, web_service VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_site_apps_owner_name UNIQUE (owner_id, name), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_site_apps_owner_id_users FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "user_packages" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	website_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '5' NOT NULL, 
	storage_limit_mb INTEGER DEFAULT '1024' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	slug VARCHAR(100), 
	database_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '5' NOT NULL, 
	alias_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	backup_retention_days INTEGER DEFAULT '7' NOT NULL, 
	terminal_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	waf_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	wordpress_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, node_apps_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, node_app_memory_mb INTEGER DEFAULT '512' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "users" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	website_limit INTEGER DEFAULT '5' NOT NULL, 
	storage_limit_mb INTEGER DEFAULT '1024' NOT NULL, 
	token_version INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	totp_secret VARCHAR(255), 
	totp_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	package_id INTEGER, terminal_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_users_package_id_user_packages FOREIGN KEY(package_id) REFERENCES user_packages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE website_aliases (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	website_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'alias' NOT NULL, 
	ssl_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(website_id) REFERENCES websites (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "websites" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	root_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	php_version VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT '8.3' NOT NULL, 
	app_type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'wordpress' NOT NULL, 
	ssl_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	nginx_custom TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	linux_user VARCHAR(32), 
	waf_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	waf_default_rules TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	waf_custom_rules TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	http_flood_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	http_flood_config TEXT DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, 
	document_root VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'public_html' NOT NULL, 
	nginx_config_mode VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'managed' NOT NULL, 
	nginx_rewrite_mode VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL, 
	ssl_mode VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL, 
	ssl_cert_path VARCHAR(500), 
	ssl_key_path VARCHAR(500), 
	ssl_ca_path VARCHAR(500), 
	ssl_updated_at DATETIME, 
	app_id INTEGER, ssl_source_domain VARCHAR(253), blocked_bots TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, crs_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_websites_app_id_site_apps FOREIGN KEY(app_id) REFERENCES site_apps (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
